dialogue.text: Alrighty...that was cool and all but it's time for us to get back to signing stuff. Thank you for your support and goodbye.

Stephanie

dialogue.text: Oh you think you're such hot shit, huh? Why don't we just let the man speak and decide on what he wants to do. You're so controlling and you um... you sound dumb!
Anyways, so Boyfriend, pretty please with a cherry on top covered with sprinkles and fudge and gummy bears and an intergalactic cinnamon swirl-
